Occurrences.Kwic: 名，蓋燈燈相續，光光涉入，義有在於是矣。噫！圓澄覺海，本含褁於十方；生滅空漚，遂沉淪於三有。因明立所，由塵發知，織妄相成，轉入諸趣，良可悲也。若迴光內照，發真歸元，則是錄也，直指性宗，單傳心印，可得於眉睫，可薦於言前，舉手而擎妙喜之世界，彈指以現莊嚴之樓閣，神通運用，真不可得而思議哉。嘉與有眾，締此勝緣，俱離迷津，偕之覺路，斯朕之志已。建中靖國元年八月十五日賜序。No.15

ExplanationParts.CorpusEarnedOpening: Singly transmit the mind-seal is a lineage formula that Chan histories and instructions pair with transmission outside written formulations.
EvidenceBody: A Blue Cliff Record preface says the visitor from the west singly transmitted the mind-seal and did not establish written words. Yuanwu Keqin says the buddhas and patriarchs proclaimed the great matter under this name and again pairs it with not establishing phrases.

Yuanwu's recorded sayings also connect Bodhidharma's journey through Liang and Wei with transmission outside the teachings and single transmission of the mind-seal. Later records preserve the same formula as a claim about the lineage, not as a private regimen.

DraftEvidence.ZenBend: Seal language becomes the named object of a single lineage transmission repeatedly contrasted with dependence on written formulations.
DraftEvidence.CounterexampleOrLimit: The formula asserts transmission in the cited records; this entry does not turn it into a doctrine of wordlessness or deny the corpus's extensive public speech.

ComparedThings: its attested grammatical and rhetorical deployments
DifferentThingTest.Reason: Nominal and verbal English renderings describe one asserted transmission relation; grammar alone does not split it.

DraftEvidence.AliasRationale: Single, singly, transmit, and transmission cover English syntax while mind-seal remains explicit in every probe.

ModifierControls.Finding: The sources themselves use single as part of the lineage assertion; it is not expanded into exclusivist doctrine beyond those statements.

FamilyControls.Finding: The shorter seal noun has broader uses; this headword includes the single-transmission predicate.
The shorter transmission formula remains independently searchable and does not donate unstored senses.
